login.title: Login to your account
login.description: Enter your email below to login to your account.
login.missingFieldsDesc: Please enter both email and password.
login.invalidEmailDesc: Please enter a valid email address.

forgot.title: Forgot Password
forgot.description: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.checkInboxDesc: If an account exists with this email, you will receive password reset instructions.
forgot.invalidEmailDesc: Please enter a valid email address.

reset.title: Reset Password
reset.successDesc: Your password has been reset successfully. Please login with your new password.
reset.missingFieldsDesc: Please enter and confirm your new password.
reset.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.description: Enter your current password and a new secure password to update your security credentials.
changePassword.missingDesc: Please fill in all password fields.
changePassword.tooShortDesc: New password must be at least 8 characters.
changePassword.mismatchDesc: New password and confirm password must be the same.
changePassword.samePasswordDesc: New password cannot be the same as the old password.
